_comment: External-resource pipeline demo — see docs/external_assets.md. Records REFERENCE user-authored .nif/.wav/.xwm by Data-relative path; `package --assets <dir>` (or spec.assets) BUNDLES them next to the .esp. ModForge does NOT generate meshes/sounds; the paths below must be authored in a DCC tool / Creation Kit and dropped into the assets dir. The placeholder tree at examples/assets/customasset/ here is empty stub content for the wiring/bundling test only.
